moodys.description: I work on a small team building and maintaining internal applications that support Moody's ratings data and workflows. Stepping into senior-level responsibilities despite being early in my career, I help drive API architecture and technical decision-making, design solutions that scale as requirements grow, and build end-to-end features spanning backend services and front-end interfaces. I also regularly partner across teams to integrate data from systems outside our own, translating business requirements into maintainable technical solutions.
bullets: Help lead API architecture and system design decisions for internal applications supporting Moody's ratings process
Build full-stack, end-to-end features — from backend services to the user interface
Collaborate cross-functionally with other engineering teams and Product stakeholders to integrate external data sources
moodys.tech: Angular, Spring Boot, NestJS, TypeScript, Java, PostgreSQL, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, REST APIs, Microservices

moodysAssociate.description: Across two teams, I contributed to the modernization of internal tools supporting Moody's ratings workflows, moving processes off of outdated, manual, and spreadsheet-dependent systems and into centralized web applications. My work spanned automating business-rule-driven calculations, building shared backend utilities used across multiple applications, and leading an architectural refactor that made an existing system more flexible and extensible, improving maintainability across 2,300+ documents. I also extended internal APIs to give other applications more flexible access to shared data. Alongside my project work, I spent two summers helping run the team's internship program — interviewing candidates, onboarding new interns, and organizing a cross-functional session series to broaden their exposure across the organization.
bullets: Automated manual, rule-based calculations as part of modernizing legacy workflows into centralized applications
Built a shared backend utility adopted across multiple internal applications
Led an architectural refactor that made an existing application more extensible and scalable, improving maintainability across 2,300+ documents
Extended internal APIs to support more flexible, consumer-driven data access
Interviewed candidates and onboarded interns for two consecutive summer internship cohorts
moodysAssociate.tech: Java, Spring Boot, Angular, TypeScript, GraphQL, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, AWS, Kubernetes, Docker, Kafka, Jenkins

slalom.description: On an all-intern team, I helped re-platform an internal contacts mobile app into a centralized web application. I contributed to the search functionality and built the UX for the results experience, including a detailed contact page, giving employees one reliable place to find and connect with each other.
bullets: Helped re-platform a mobile contacts app into a web application, building the MVP search feature and results UI
